items.title: Long-WAM: Scaling the Context of World-Action Models
items.summary: Real-time robot control demands enough visual history to infer motion and task progress, but processing that history can delay action. We present Long-WAM, a model-system framework for scaling the context of causal world-action models under real-time control constraints. items.summary: Highly compressed video autoencoders offer an effective way to accelerate video diffusion models, as the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) operates on far fewer tokens. items.summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable potential in video understanding, yet their reliance on retrospective summarization and text-centric priors often limits their ability to bridge unobserved causal transitions when applied to Video Event Prediction (VEP). items.title: UltraText Bench: A Comprehensive Bilingual Benchmark for Evaluating Visual Text Rendering in Image Generation
items.summary: Dense visual text requires image generators to reproduce long strings across multiple regions with correct placement and legibility. As short-string rendering improves, evaluation must test sustained performance across more demanding scenes. items.summary: We propose Tetris3D, a generative framework for single-image 3D scene reconstruction that recovers objects which are physically and geometrically coherent as a scene. items.summary: Much knowledge work produces new deliverables from files a workspace already holds, and LLM agents are beginning to take such work over. items.summary: General-purpose agents increasingly write code, use tools, and complete complex digital tasks, raising the question of how far these capabilities carry into the physical world. items.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has become an important approach to language model post-training. items.summary: Astra can act, yet reliable manipulation depends on the system through which it observes and controls the world. We introduce PhysEvo, a framework for physical recursive self-improvement (RSI) around a single frozen model. items.summary: We introduce SWE-Game, a benchmark of 247 tasks grounded in 41 executable reference Godot games spanning 13 gameplay categories in 2D and 3D. items.title: VIEScore2: Unified Image Evaluation with Spatially Grounded Explanations
items.summary: Existing synthetic image evaluators typically provide only a scalar quality score and do not identify the image regions that support it. items.title: NAMVIS: Next-Scale Autoregressive Multi-View Image Synthesis
items.summary: Sparse-view novel view synthesis is a central problem in 3D content creation, but diffusion-based approaches remain limited by iterative denoising, making multi-view generation expensive at inference time. items.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has been widely studied as a post-training method in which a student model obtains token-level supervision from a stronger teacher on its own rollouts. items.summary: We introduce QuadTok, a novel framework for visual tokenization and autoregressive image generation. items.summary: Proactive AI assistants continuously observe a user's activity and decide whether to provide new guidance or remain silent.
